answer: The grove census binds one newcomer to one tree on the knoll. At zenith the beacon publishes a leaf-code; the steward hangs it on the tree within two hours and posts a note with the code, the tree, and one morning task. Two keepers check each note against the ledger that afternoon; a wrong code, a twice-claimed tree, or a missed zenith burns the $5 bond. One steward spends $5 and a morning; faking a hundred means a hundred climbs at zenith and $500 locked.
